gelain_2020_cellulose_10gl.source: Declared sensitivity assumption only: SD=10% of training maxima, biomass/substrate correlation=-0.5 from the sign suggested by mass-difference assays. Neither magnitude is measured; temporal errors assumed independent.
gelain_2020_cellulose_10gl.supports: zero or one left-censored component per simultaneous row
